title: Baseball in the park on Paseo and the tearing down of old places
summary: He remembers playing ball in a park on Paseo and the sadness of finding those houses torn down when he returned.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And after that, used to love to play baseball. Tell you about breakin' out all the windows in the school. So they got so we go play ball in the park. So it was on...was on...between two streets. Wasn't a very big park. Had a lot of vines and bushes and things. Street's still there in Kansas City, called Paseo. Used to have a lot of houses...big flats, all up and down the side of the streets.

I went back there after three or four years ago...four or five years ago maybe, and they was tearin'...tore down all them places. Me-- I don't know why I expected it to look like it did when I was a kid but that was just somethin' I had in my mind. And it kinda made me feel bad to see all them tearin' down all them old places 'cause they been there for years. They need to tear 'em down.
